newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT- Banco de Galicia upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Banco de Galicia upgraded.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Tuesday it upgraded Argentina's Banco de Galicia to buy from market perfrom.
-- "We are upgrading Galicia to a buy rating, as we believe it is an attractive proxy for the expanding Argentine banking sector," analysts Walter Kiceleff and Simon Smithson wrote in a report.

-- "Galicia's appeal is backed by the following factors: 1) it is a leader in regional exposure; 2) it has a healthy loan portfolio; and 3) it has proven expertise in the highly competitive consumer and middle-market segments."
-- Additionally, the Argentine banking sector is one of the most attractive in Latin America, they said.
-- "As a superior bank stock, Galicia should be a core holding in any long-term Argentine portfolio," they added.
